design_philosophy: A highly functional, dense, back-office ERP interface. Avoiding all 'AI slop' tropes (no soft gradients, no purple/teal, no oversized shadows, no pill shapes). Emphasizing crisp lines, 1px borders, high contrast, and monospace numerals for absolute precision. The visual anchor is a deep black sidebar with a pure white main content area and a sharp industrial amber/yellow accent.

typography.heading_strategy: Functional and dense. No oversized text. Use IBM Plex Sans with tight tracking.

layout_and_spacing.shadows: None. Rely on 1px solid borders (border-zinc-200) for separation.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Dense). Minimal gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). High data density.

components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. Deep black (#09090B). Icons + Labels. Clean hover states (bg-zinc-800).
components.topbar: Thin, sticky top bar. Contains breadcrumbs, global search (small input), and profile menu. Border-bottom 1px.
components.cards: White background, border-zinc-200, NO shadow. Very flat and technical.
components.tables: Dense. Header bg-zinc-50, text-xs uppercase text-zinc-500 tracking-wider. Cells have border-b. Numbers must use font-mono.
components.buttons: Square/small radius. Primary buttons are solid black with white text. Secondary buttons are white with border-zinc-300.
components.forms: 2-column layouts for transactions. Inputs have 1px border-zinc-300, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-900. No soft outlines.
components.badges: Flat color backgrounds with dark text. E.g., Amber bg for 'Stok Menipis' with monospace count.

login.layout: 2-column split screen. Left side: clean white form container. Right side: industrial scaffolding image cover.

login_background.description: Industrial scaffolding site for login screen background

instructions_to_main_agent: Install @phosphor-icons/react and import fonts 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'IBM Plex Mono'.
Use standard HTML inputs or customized Shadcn without heavy borders/shadows (radius 4px).
Apply 'font-mono' to ALL numbers in tables, cards, and summaries.
Do NOT use standard Tailwind blue/indigo as primary colors. Stick strictly to black/white/zinc with amber accents.
For slide-overs, use fixed inset-y-0 right-0 with a solid background and a left border.
Ensure the dashboard feels like a dense tool, not a consumer app.
